name: The Circle of La Cabotina
summary: Perched high in the Ligurian Alps, the medieval village of Triora is often called the 'Salem of Italy.'
lore: When a devastating famine struck the region in 1587, local authorities blamed a gathering of women who met at La Cabotina—a desolate, cavernous rock formation outside the village walls. The women were accused of holding late-night rites, manipulating crop yields, and shape-shifting. Today, Triora embraces this dark chapter of history with preserved medieval architecture and local lore dedicated to the Cabotina circle.

events.title: The Famine's Scapegoats
events.narrative: The harvest has failed again, and the villagers of Triora are whispering that the Cabotina circle is to blame. A mob gathers at the rock formation with torches.

choiceA.label: Face the mob and speak calm
choiceA.description: +20% Faith if they disperse, −6 Followers if they don't

random.winMessage: Your words turn the mob's fear to awe. They lower their torches and drift home. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The mob will not be calmed. Six of your circle are named and must flee into the mountains. −6 Followers.

choiceB.label: Slip away and meet in the high pastures

events.title: The Sanremo Garden-Witches
events.narrative: The herbalists of Sanremo have been growing poisonous plants among their flowers and selling subtle deaths to the Riviera nobility. They encroach on your circle's domain of secret craft.

events.title: The Imperia Olive-Casters
events.narrative: The olive-grove witches of Imperia have read the future in oil-on-water and claim a great reckoning is coming for your circle. They offer to share the reading — for a price.

choiceA.label: Pay them and hear the omen

choiceB.label: Read the oil yourself
choiceB.description: +20% Faith if right, −4 Followers if wrong

random.winMessage: Your reading proves true. The reckoning is averted, and the Imperia witches concede your power. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: You misread the oil. The reckoning falls, and four of your circle are lost. −4 Followers.

events.title: The Taggia Shape-Shifters
events.narrative: The mountain-village shifters of Taggia have become wolves and are raiding the lowland flocks under the full moon. The shepherds blame your circle by association.

choiceA.label: Bind them back to human form

choiceB.label: Let them run and grow your flock

events.title: The Rite at the Rock
events.narrative: Tonight the moon is right for the old rite at the Cabotina rock formation. But the local magistrate has posted a watcher on the path.

choiceA.label: Hold the rite and evade the watcher
choiceA.description: +25% Faith if unseen, −5 Followers if caught

random.winMessage: You slip past the watcher and complete the rite under the moon. The circle is renewed. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The watcher raises the alarm. Five of your number are named and must flee. −5 Followers.

choiceB.label: Postpone and meet in the caves

events.title: The Inquisitor from Genoa
events.narrative: An inquisitor arrives from Genoa with a list of names gathered during the famine trials. He is patient, methodical, and well-guarded.

choiceA.label: Deny all and hide the circle's tools

choiceB.label: Turn the village's fear against him
choiceB.description: +15% Faith if it works, −6 Followers if it fails

random.winMessage: The villagers refuse to testify. The inquisitor leaves empty-handed. +15% Faith.
random.lossMessage: He extracts testimony by fear. Six of your circle are named and taken. −6 Followers.

events.title: The Wolf That Would Not Return
events.narrative: One of your circle shifted to wolf-form three nights ago and has not come back. Her body lies cold in the cave; her spirit roams the high forests.

choiceA.label: Seek her spirit in the wolf-dream

choiceB.label: Declare her a martyr of the circle

events.title: A Ligurian Noble's Patronage
events.narrative: A noblewoman from the coast arrives at Triora with a heavy chest of silver. 'My rival at court has cursed my house. The priests are useless. I am told your circle knows the old ways.'

choiceA.label: Accept her silver and lift the curse

events.title: The Poison Garden Blooms
events.narrative: Your circle's hidden garden of poisonous plants has bloomed earlier than expected. The apothecary warns that the scent alone could sicken the village.

choiceB.label: Burn the bloom and prophesy safety

events.title: A Wandering Herbalist
events.narrative: A gaunt woman with a satchel of alpine herbs arrives at the Cabotina rock. 'I have walked from the French border. I know every poison and cure between here and Nice. I seek a circle.'
